title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: migrate environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and the documented preview migration, including downtime, one-way management changes, capacity requirements and Commerce restrictions. The checklist's instruction to review environment administrator access has no corresponding controls-table row; this is a minor completeness issue.

claims.claim: Self-service migration moves management of an existing finance and operations environment from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Finance and operations apps require appropriate product subscription licences, such as Dynamics 365 Finance or Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.
claims.quote: Customers must acquire and assign appropriate subscription licenses for their users ... Example: Dynamics 365 Commerce, Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, Dynamics 365 Team Members, and more.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included in the finance and operations product entitlement, rather than a published migration-specific entitlement.
claims.quote: When you purchase a license for any finance and operations app, such as Dynamics 365 Finance or Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, your tenant is granted various entitlements.

claims.claim: The migration page lists no licence among its migration prerequisites.
claims.quote: Searched: migration license price billing. Opened the migration page and read its full Prerequisites section: Commerce, Deployed health, Power Platform link, capacity, administrator, ALM preparation, maintenance window and user notice; no licence is listed.

claims.quote: Searched: Lifecycle Services migration Power Platform admin center migration license price billing. Opened migration, unified admin overview, integration and user licensing pages; product licences and capacity are documented, but no migration-specific licence.

claims.quote: Environment is in Deployed status. Power Platform environment is linked. Database storage capacity is available. You are an administrator of the linked Power Platform environment.

claims.claim: Lifecycle Services > project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center reaches the migration action.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... In the Environments section ... select Full details. ... expand Power Platform migration (Preview). ... Select Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for starting this Lifecycle Services-to-Power Platform management migration.
claims.quote: Searched: Lifecycle Services Power Platform environment migration start migration API REST PowerShell pac admin. Opened migration page; read pac admin and environment-management search excerpts. Copy, tenant migration and operation-status APIs do not start this management migration.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Capacity add-ons > Finance and Operations reaches the documented storage capacity report.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Licensing. ... In the Licensing pane, select Capacity add-ons. ... Select Finance and Operations.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the finance and operations storage report specifically.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations storage capacity report API; Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment Capacity finance operations. Opened storage report and daily capacity tutorial; read cmdlet reference excerpts. Generic Database/File/Log consumption is shown, not this Operations usage-versus-entitlement report.

claims.claim: Lifecycle Services > project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Power Platform environment is linked reaches the link prerequisite check.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... select Full details. ... expand Power Platform migration (Preview). ... Verify ... Power Platform environment is linked.

claims.claim: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails verifies integration status, not migration or link configuration.
claims.quote: The RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails API is available in Dataverse to validate the status of the Power Platform integration ... GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails

claims.claim: The Dataverse integration status API reports the link and returns finance and operations tenant and environment details.
claims.quote: If the Power Platform environment is linked to a finance and operations apps environment through the Power Platform integration, the API returns the Microsoft Entra tenant and environment details of the finance and operations apps environment.

claims.claim: The cited integration page does not state which role may call RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails.
claims.quote: Searched: RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails API permissions role. Opened integration page and read its full runtime API section; no caller role is specified. Other returned permission pages concern Finance Agent and Azure APIs, not this Dataverse function.

claims.claim: The existing finance and operations storage report compares usage with entitlement and is linked by the migration page for deficit remediation.
claims.quote: The finance and operations storage capacity report shows how much finance and operations storage your organization is using compared with how much its license entitles it to.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The guidance tells readers to review administrator access, but the controls table has no administrator-access management row.
claims.quote: review who holds that role before migration day; agree who will be the administrator of that linked environment. The table has migration initiation, storage reporting and integration-status checks, but no access-management control.
claims.fix: The instruction to review who holds the linked-environment administrator role has no corresponding controls-table row. Remove 'so review who holds that role before migration day' and narrow the checklist clause to 'confirm the person starting migration is an administrator of the linked environment'; do not add a new control row.
